versions.changelog:
afrexai-seo-content-engine 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive SEO content creation system.
- Enables keyword research, competitor analysis, article writing, and ranking tracking through conversational workflows.
- No API integration or subscriptions required; utilizes web search and structured SEO frameworks.
- Includes step-by-step keyword research, search intent classification, and competition analysis guidance.
- Provides article planning, content briefs, writing frameworks, and on-page SEO checklists.
- Supports organizing articles into content clusters and building topical authority.
